arms.aer_noise_model: Aer density-matrix simulation of the ISA circuits under a generic model: depolarizing error on every one-qubit gate (rz included) at the target's median one-qubit error, depolarizing error on every two-qubit gate at its median two-qubit error, and a symmetric readout error at its median readout error; no thermal relaxation
arms.exact: the exact lumped time average of the walk, by the coefficient recurrence on the retained operator (NumPy; no circuit)
arms.fake_marrakesh: Aer density-matrix simulation of the ISA circuits under NoiseModel.from_backend on the FakeMarrakesh calibration snapshot: per-gate depolarizing and thermal-relaxation errors and per-qubit readout errors
arms.noiseless_shots: Aer sampling of the ideal ISA circuits: shot noise only (statevector of the touched qubits, config.hardware_shots shots per circuit)

extra.growth_rule: nested connected growth from the reference class with the most restart mass, adding at each step the class sharing the most category nodes with the retained set (ties: larger restart mass, then key order); quantum.hardware.class_candidates.grow_connected_classes
extra.padding_convention: padding codes carry uniform columns in G_pad (quantum.hardware.structured_circuit); measured mass on padding codes is removed and the retained support renormalised
extra.readout_calibration: Readout calibration is per circuit. Routing places the measured (source) register on different physical qubits in different per-step circuits, so the circuits are grouped by their measured-qubit tuple; each distinct tuple gets one calibration set (the baseline circuit and one single-flip circuit per measured qubit, transpiled onto exactly those qubits and run on the arm's own simulator) and every circuit is mitigated with the set of its own tuple. The shard records the tuples and the index of the set each circuit used (circuit_to_calibration).

selection.rule: max fidelity_ratio under fake_marrakesh at tau >= 2; n_masked_groups >= 2 if any such instance reaches 0.5; estimated QPU <= 300.0 s; m <= 6

columns.compatibility_residual: max |D B - B D_bar| of the same pair
columns.fraction_columns_full_reference_support: share of columns with support on every reference copy
columns.gbar_density: share of non-zero entries of G_bar
columns.instance: full lumped operator or a nested retained instance (label)
columns.lumpability_residual: max |C G - G_bar C| of the retained operator against the member-level operator of the same classes
columns.n_masked_groups: distinct masked classes the instance retains
columns.route: discriminant the router selects for the retained operator against its member-level operator (D_bar or H); null when the instance was not simulated (not routed)
columns.two_qubit_logical_analytic: analytic two-qubit count of one reflection--swap
columns.two_qubit_logical_transpiled: two-qubit count of one logical step after a basis transpilation (no routing), where m allows it

columns.aer_noise_model: time-averaged measured probability under the aer_noise_model arm (raw); null when the cell was not simulated
columns.aer_noise_model_mitigated: the same after per-circuit readout mitigation (aer_noise_model)
columns.exact: exact time-averaged source probability at the selected tau
columns.fake_marrakesh: time-averaged measured probability under the fake_marrakesh arm (raw); null when the cell was not simulated
columns.fake_marrakesh_mitigated: the same after per-circuit readout mitigation (fake_marrakesh)
columns.label: the node's label in the lumped graph
columns.layer_index: layer of a borrower copy (null for a category node)
columns.noiseless_shots: time-averaged measured probability under the noiseless_shots arm (raw); null when the cell was not simulated
columns.supra_node: supra-node index of the retained instance (the row of its lumped node table)

columns.active_qubits: physical qubits the routed circuits touch (max over t < tau)
columns.arm: noiseless_shots, aer_noise_model or fake_marrakesh; the arms are defined in the instance record (hardware_candidates.json, 'arms') and the manifest
columns.basis: native two-qubit gates of the target
columns.compatibility_residual: max |D B - B D_bar| of the retained operator
columns.depth_max: maximal transpiled depth over the circuits t < tau
columns.estimated_gates: ISA gates summed over the circuits t < tau (the work of the cell)
columns.estimated_qpu_seconds: ESTIMATED QPU seconds of a hand-run submission of this cell: shots x sum over the walk circuits and one calibration set per distinct measured-qubit tuple of (depth x two-qubit duration + readout + repetition delay)
columns.estimated_simulation_seconds: estimated wall seconds of the cell, decided before it ran: ISA gates x state bytes x the arm's measured seconds per gate and byte (that of its kind, or config.hardware_prior_bytes_per_second, before the arm has run); wall_seconds is what it took
columns.estimated_state_bytes: bytes of the simulated state at the touched-qubit width (16 * 4^n density matrix, 16 * 2^n statevector)
columns.estimated_two_qubit_logical: analytic logical two-qubit gates of one reflection--swap, for an instance wider than the register cap
columns.lumpability_residual: max |C G - G_bar C| of the retained operator
columns.mitigated: whether per-circuit readout mitigation was applied to the arm's counts (noisy arms only)
columns.n_calibration_sets: distinct measured-qubit tuples among the circuits t < tau, i.e. calibration sets used (per-circuit calibration)
columns.noise: what the arm simulates; for aer_noise_model: depolarizing 1q/2q errors and a symmetric readout error at the FakeMarrakesh medians, no thermal relaxation; for fake_marrakesh: its calibration-derived model; for noiseless_shots: no noise
columns.padding_mass: mean measured mass on padding codes (removed and the rest renormalised)
columns.predicted_survival_min: conservative predicted survival (every one-qubit gate at the one-qubit median), min over the circuits
columns.pure_noise_fidelity_hi: upper quantile of the same distribution; a raw cell carries signal when its fidelity_ratio is above this
columns.pure_noise_fidelity_lo: lower quantile of the fidelity ratio of a pure-noise output against this instance's exact average
columns.pure_noise_spearman_hi: upper quantile of the same distribution
columns.pure_noise_spearman_lo: lower quantile (config.hardware_noise_band_quantiles[0] percent) of the Spearman of a pure-noise output against this instance's own exact average at this tau, over config.hardware_noise_band_draws draws; a pure-noise output is config.hardware_shots shots of uniform random codes per circuit, converted and averaged like a measured output
columns.reason: why the cell was not simulated, with the estimate
columns.route: discriminant the router selects for the retained operator (D_bar or H)
columns.signal_above_band: whether the raw cell carries signal: fidelity_ratio strictly above pure_noise_fidelity_hi, the upper edge of its own pure-noise band (one-sided; a value on the edge or below the band is not signal); null for mitigated and not simulated cells
columns.spearman_masked_classes: Spearman over the class probabilities (layer copies summed) of the masked classes; null with fewer than two
columns.spearman_supra: Spearman against the exact time average over the R supra-nodes
columns.spent_seconds: simulation seconds already spent on the instance when the cell was declined
columns.status: 'not simulated: resource budget' for a cell that was not simulated; empty otherwise
columns.tv: total variation to the exact time average
columns.tv_uniform: total variation between uniform and the exact time average
columns.two_qubit_sum: two-qubit gates summed over the circuits t < tau
columns.wall_seconds: wall seconds the cell took to simulate (transpilation to the simulator basis included)

columns.R: supra-nodes of the full lumped operator
columns.max_abs_error: max |circuit source probability - NumPy lumped walk| over steps
columns.probe_seconds: wall seconds of the two-step probe

columns.arm_key: short arm key used by the number map
columns.padding: mean measured mass on padding codes
columns.qpu_kind: 'estimated' for every simulated arm; 'none' for the exact row
columns.rho: Spearman against the exact time average over the R supra-nodes
columns.rho_masked: Spearman over the class probabilities of the masked classes (null when fewer than two)
columns.rho_masked_note: 'single group' when the masked-class Spearman is undefined
columns.tv: total variation to the exact time average
columns.tv_uniform: total variation between uniform and exact

columns.flag: selection flag (empty, or 'cannot rank test borrowers')
columns.hw_2q: summed two-qubit gates over the per-time circuits
columns.hw_backend: the calibration snapshot every simulated arm reads (a fake backend; nothing ran on hardware)
columns.hw_calibration_sets: distinct measured-qubit tuples among the selected cell's circuits: readout calibration sets used (per circuit)
columns.hw_depth: maximal transpiled depth over the per-time circuits
columns.hw_qpu_s: estimated QPU seconds of the selected cell (shots x (depth x gate time + measurement + repetition delay))
columns.hw_rankable_fr: largest raw fake_marrakesh fidelity ratio of that instance over its simulated cells at tau >= hardware_min_tau (null when none was simulated)
columns.hw_rankable_k: classes of the first instance able to rank test borrowers: the smallest k that retains two or more masked classes (null when no instance does)
columns.hw_rankable_signal: whether that cell carries signal: its fidelity ratio is strictly above the upper edge of its own pure-noise band
columns.hw_route: discriminant the router selects for the retained operator against its member-level operator (D_bar or H)
columns.hw_survival: conservative predicted survival probability, min over the circuits
columns.hw_tau: recorded steps of the selected cell
columns.hw_tv_uniform: total variation between the uniform distribution and the exact time average
columns.n_masked_groups: distinct masked classes the instance retains
columns.noise_k_band: entry point over instances: the smallest number of classes k such that neither it nor any larger evaluated k carries signal in the raw fake_marrakesh output; each k is judged at its longest simulated walk (the largest tau >= hardware_min_tau) and signal means a fidelity ratio strictly above the upper edge of its own pure-noise band; 'none' when no evaluated k satisfies it
columns.noise_k_band_aer_noise_model: the same entry point for the aer_noise_model arm
columns.noise_k_band_fake_marrakesh: the same as noise_k_band, named by arm
columns.noise_tau_band: entry point over steps, for the selected instance: the first tau >= hardware_min_tau at which its raw fake_marrakesh cell carries no signal, or '> <tau>' (its largest simulated tau) when every one does; 'not evaluated' without a simulated cell
columns.noise_tau_band_aer_noise_model: the same first tau for the aer_noise_model arm
columns.noise_tau_band_fake_marrakesh: the same as noise_tau_band, named by arm
